title: Why Did Franklin Never Patent the Lightning Rod?
description:
Full film: Benjamin Franklin's Kite Experiment Explained — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YqCWYlv_LCY

Benjamin Franklin never patented his lightning rod — he wanted everyone to have it. Within a few years, lightning rods were going up on churches, houses, and ships' masts, turning church towers into safer places to stand.

Pictures: AI-generated 3D scenes. Facts: every claim is checked against the sources for the full film.
